Quick answers

Do I need land before calling?

No. But if you have land, the site-package estimate can get more specific.

Can Mustang Creek help with septic/water/electric?

Yes — the site is built to make those items part of the plan instead of an afterthought.

Are these Deer Valley and Champion homes?

Yes. This mockup includes Deer Valley and Champion model references for review. Confirm final brand/photo permissions before publishing live.

What makes this different?
